data.name: Philis
data.gender_notes: Philis is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Philis was a Phrygian princess who fell in love with the god Apollo while disguised as a man. When her true identity was revealed, Apollo was moved by her devotion and granted her a wish. The name Philis carries the meaning “Lover of horses” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Philis usually hope their child will grow to embody lover of horses and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Philis belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lover of horses.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Philis total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hebrew.name: פיליס
in_hebrew.meaning: פיליס משמעות שם נועדה לשמוח ולשמח
in_hebrew.long_meaning: פיליס הוא שם שמקורו ביוונית ומשמעותו 'אוהבת סוסים'. השם נגזר מהמילה היוונית 'φιλος' (פילוס) שמשמעותה 'חבר' או 'אוהב' ו- 'ιππος' (היפוס) שמשמעותו 'סוס'. השם פיליס משמש כנראה כמקביל לשם העברי 'פיליס' שגם הוא קשור לנושא האהבה והחברות. השם מופיע בתנ"ך ומתאר אישה יפה ומושכת.

in_greek.name: Φίλις
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Φίλις προέρχεται από τις ελληνικές λέξεις 'φίλος' (φίλος) που σημαίνει 'φίλος' ή 'απευθυνόμενος' και 'ίππος' (ίππος) που σημαίνει 'ιππος'. Στην ελληνική μυθολογία, το όνομα συνδέεται με την αγάπη για τα άλογα και την ομορφιά. Το όνομα χρησιμοποιήθηκε στην αρχαία Ελλάδα και διατηρήθηκε στην παράδοση των ονομάτων στην Εκκλησία.

in_latin.name: Philis
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Philis originates from the Greek words 'philos' meaning 'lover' or 'friend' and 'hippos' meaning 'horse'. In Latin, the name Philis signifies a person with a strong affinity for horses, reflecting qualities of strength, beauty, and elegance. The name Philis has been used in Christian tradition to denote someone with a gentle and kind spirit.

in_english.name: Philis
in_english.meaning: Lover of horses, beautiful, and kind-hearted
in_english.long_meaning: The name Philis originates from the Greek roots 'philos' (love) and 'hippos' (horse), signifying a deep affection for horses. Historically, the name Philis has been associated with kindness, elegance, and a strong connection to nature.
